name: Price is Right, The Poker
description: Price is Right Poker is an American poker variant themed on the TV game show. Players use a standard 52-card deck and standard poker hand rankings; gameplay combines hand-building with guessing or bidding on prices. Two to six players compete to form the best hand.

overview.description: Price is Right Poker is an American poker variant themed on the TV game show. Players use a standard 52-card deck and standard poker hand rankings; gameplay combines hand-building with guessing or bidding on prices. Two to six players compete to form the best hand.

history.origins: American TV game show themed poker variant; inspired by The Price Is Right; combines poker hand rankings with guessing or bidding on prices.
timeline: 20th century: American home game variant based on The Price Is Right TV show.
history.cultural: American living-room poker culture and TV game show influence.
history.evolution: Home game variant that added price-guessing or bidding rounds to standard poker.

setup.dealing: Dealer gives each player five cards; the remainder stays as stock.
setup.equipment: Standard 52-card deck and poker chips or tokens for price-guessing rounds.

rules.objective: Win by having the best poker hand at showdown; price-guessing or bidding rounds may award bonuses or determine order.
rules.gameplay: Deal five cards to each player. Play proceeds with price-guessing or bidding rounds themed on The Price Is Right, then betting or showdown. Best standard poker hand wins.
keyRules: Price-guessing or bidding may be used before or between betting rounds.

strategy.basic: Build the strongest five-card hand; use standard poker hand values.
strategy.intermediate: Time price guesses to avoid going over; balance hand strength with participation in theme rounds.
strategy.advanced: Read opponents' bets and price bids to infer hand strength.
tips: Closest to the price without going over mirrors the TV show rule.

variations.name: Price Guess Bonus
variations.description: Before showdown, one item is priced; closest guess without going over wins a chip bonus added to the pot.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation describes optional price-guess bonus; no engine overrides needed.
